detail.longDescription: OpenAI and Anthropic models can read text and look at images just fine, but video is a big no-no. If you're building a tool or a product that absolutely needs that type of media, you'd have to engineer a long workaround, decomposing it into multiple images and then feeding them as an input. A big techie flex if you manage to do it, but is it worth the time? Google has the answer if you want to go faster.
